components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark-theme translation of the WPF primary action. Minimum 40-unit control, native focus, no authored motion.
components.css: .ds-btn { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #485A4E; border-radius: 4px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #D5E998; color: #172119; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #D5E998; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #F0EFE6; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Shared secondary action, with panel fill and border-based hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #485A4E; border-radius: 4px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1E2623; color: #F0EFE6; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #D5E998; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #F0EFE6; outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Dark-theme search field with muted placeholder, accent caret, and selected-text fill.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Find a mod or hero" placeholder="Find a mod or hero" />
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #485A4E; border-radius: 4px; background: #101613; color: #F0EFE6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; caret-color: #D5E998; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #B8C3B9; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #F0EFE6; outline: none; } .ds-input::selection { background: #303D2D; color: #F0EFE6; }

components.name: Hero and Mod Type Pickers
components.description: Independent native hero and mod-type popups with searchable aliases, keyboard selection, explicit empty states, counts and reset. Type counts follow the selected or searched hero; all providers remain internal.
components.html: <section class="ds-category"><button class="ds-select">All heroes</button><button class="ds-select">All mod types</button><input class="ds-input" aria-label="Find a hero" placeholder="Find a hero"><button class="ds-select">Paige</button></section>
components.css: .ds-category { width:360px; padding:12px; border:1px solid #485A4E; border-radius:4px; background:#1E2623; font:14px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-select, .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; display:block; width:100%; min-height:40px; margin-bottom:8px; padding:10px; border:1px solid #485A4E; border-radius:4px; color:#F0EFE6; background:#101613; font:inherit; text-align:left; } .ds-input::placeholder {color:#B8C3B9;} .ds-select:focus-visible, .ds-input:focus {outline:1px solid #F0EFE6;}

components.name: Catalog Cover Tile
components.description: Catalog and Favorites use an adaptive cover grid, a two-line title and caption, shared selection/focus boundaries, lazy loading and bilingual missing-image states. The native library retains sortable rows. Compact viewports reduce cover height to keep names readable.
components.css: .ds-tile {box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-width:220px; padding:8px; border:1px solid #485A4E; border-radius:4px; background:#1E2623; color:#F0EFE6; text-align:left; font-family:"Segoe UI",sans-serif;} .ds-cover {aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:3px; background:#101613; color:#B8C3B9; display:grid; place-items:center;} .ds-tile-title {display:block; height:44px; margin:12px 4px 0; font-size:16px; line-height:22px; font-weight:600; overflow:hidden;} .ds-tile-meta {display:block; height:34px; margin:4px; color:#B8C3B9; font-size:12px; line-height:17px; overflow:hidden;} .ds-tile[aria-pressed="true"] {background:#303D2D; border-color:#D5E998;} .ds-tile:hover {border-color:#809070;} .ds-tile:focus-visible {border-color:#F0EFE6; outline:none;}

components.name: Game Status Band
components.description: Persistent game/index context. Text is an illustrative state, not a detected installation or verified result.
components.html:
Game state
Catalog index status

components.css: .ds-status { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; background: #1E2623; color: #F0EFE6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-meta, .ds-status-path { margin-top: 4px; color: #B8C3B9; font-size: 12px; } .ds-status-path { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Native button navigation with a primary style for the active page across all five destinations. The preview shows Catalog active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-button { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #485A4E; border-radius: 4px; background: #1E2623; color: #F0EFE6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active { background: #D5E998; color: #172119; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-button:hover { border-color: #D5E998; } .ds-nav-button:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #F0EFE6; outline: none; } .ds-nav-button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Detail Panel
components.description: Selected-item context; preview content is illustrative. Actual native pane scrolls and contains actionable variants and requirements.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-detail { box-sizing: border-box; width: 380px; max-width: 100%; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #485A4E; border-radius: 4px; background: #1E2623; color: #F0EFE6; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-detail-title { margin: 12px 0 8px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-detail-meta { margin: 0 0 16px; color: #B8C3B9; } .ds-detail-body { margin: 0 0 16px; line-height: 21px; }

narrative.overview: An extracted native Windows utility, not a replacement identity. Moss-toned tonal layers and a restrained lime accent preserve scanability while a list/detail workspace keeps the selected mod in context. Segoe UI, fixed sizes, compact controls, native dialogs, visible keyboard focus, and direct bilingual copy serve the task. Frontmatter owns primitives. These browser snippets translate WPF controls at 96 DPI for inspection; they are not application implementation or claims of additional behavior.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve the accent for actions, selection, and meaningful status; use neutrals for inactive rows and supporting text.

rules.name: The Task Type Rule
rules.body: Keep fixed desktop sizes and familiar UI typography.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use tones and thin boundaries; no authored resting shadows, glow, or decorative motion.

dos: Use role-matched light/dark resources from the runtime palette.
Retain visible focus and clear bilingual actions.
Preserve list/detail context and visible game state.
Wrap long names and messages at the minimum window size.
Distinguish downloading, selection, pending changes, and application.
donts: Do not add unsupported capabilities through copy.
Do not replace native behavior with unfamiliar web affordances.
Do not introduce decorative shadows, glass, motion, display fonts, or large pills.
Do not claim mobile layouts, continuous live OS-theme synchronization, or unimplemented navigation states.
